name: Ane to Imouto o Iinari ni Suru 10 no Kairitsu ~Hou mo Shimai mo Okashitsukuse!~
original_name: 姉と妹をいいなりにする10の戒律～法も姉妹も犯しつくせ！～
source:
This is the story of a boy who had three sexy sisters.
They kind of overwhelmed him and made him their yes-man.

"I hate this! Some day I'll turn the tables!" he vowed.

Well, that day has come - an angel has visited upon him,
bequeathing a tablet of ten spaces so he can write his own...
TEN COMMANDMENTS! for his sisters to follow! 

[From [url=http://eng.dlsite.com/work/=/product_id/RE072263.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
这是一个拥有三个性感姐妹的男孩的故事。
他们让他不知所措，让他成了他们的唯唯诺诺的人。

“我讨厌这个！总有一天我会扭转局面！”他发誓。

好吧，那一天已经到来——一位天使拜访了他，
遗赠一块有十个空格的牌匾，以便他可以自己写……
十诫！让他的姐妹们跟随！

[来自[url=http://eng.dlsite.com/work/=/product_id/RE072263.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
